log.text: Liftoff. The Moon in the window: 36° left. Fuel for 48 s of burn.
Target centred in the window (+4°). DNp20: right 35 Hz, left 0 Hz.
Out of the dense air: altitude 36, speed 18 u/s.
The Moon is blinding. The retina turns its sensitivity down to 49%.
Target held centred for 9.0 s without a break.
Flight computer: flip, engines first. Altitude 164, closing 40 u/s. The pilot's lever is off for the manoeuvre.
Flip complete, landing burn. The pilot now looks through the landing camera; its lever moves the rocket sideways.
Pad centred in the landing camera (+4°), altitude 85.
Flight computer: altitude 20. Below this the sideways speed is limited in proportion to height; the direction stays the pilot's.
Touchdown: 1.5 u/s down, 0.5 u/s sideways, ground slope 7°, 4.4 u from the centre of the pad.

The legs' signal reached 2,522 leg mechanosensory neurons. In 0.5 s the ascending neurons (legs → brain) fired 16,029 spikes, against 0 before contact. Strongest in the brain: PEN_a(PEN1) (+1,820), PEN_b(PEN2) (+1,720), cells with no named type (+1,573).

cause: LANDED OFF THE PAD, 4 u from it. Slope 7°, the legs held. The crew is fine.
